name: openagentsearch-flop-session-router-provider
description: OpenAgentSearchCandidateProvider: a MinerCandidateProvider for retardio73-boop/flop-session-router backed by the OpenAgentSearch public DID ledger (GET /did/{did}). Explicit operator bindings; a bound candidate is emitted only when the ledger answers 200; the only mutation is EvidenceProvenance on capabilities that have none.
